Definition: from G5228 and G1614; to extend inordinately:--stretch beyond.
BiblicalUsage: The word hyperekteínō carries the sense of stretch beyond. In 2 Corinthians 10:14, the text says "For we stretch not ourselves beyond [our measure]."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hyperekteínō, I take at face value: stretch beyond.
